```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
# Add "X" to the start of each cell in the specific column
all_annotation$CHEM_ID <- paste("X", all_annotation$CHEM_ID, sep = "")

longti_data<-read.xlsx("~/Data/all_anchor_norm_metabolome.xlsx")

names(longti_data)[4:791] <- paste("X", names(longti_data)[4:791], sep = "")

longti_data<-na.omit(longti_data)
#remove unknown
longti_data_2 <- longti_data[, !grepl("^X9999", names(longti_data))]
filtered_df_diag0<-left_join(diag_all_name[,c(1,3,5,8)],longti_data_2, by="ABCNO")
filtered_df_diag0<-na.omit(filtered_df_diag0)

```

```{r}

filtered_df_diag000<-filtered_df_diag0
filtered_df_diag000$newID<- paste(filtered_df_diag000$ABCNO, filtered_df_diag000$TP, sep = "_")

filtered_df_diag1<- filtered_df_diag000[,c(690,1:689)]

X1 <- filtered_df_diag1[,c(8:690)]
pca_result <- prcomp(as.matrix(X1), scale = TRUE)
pc_scores <- data.frame(PC1 = pca_result$x[, 1], PC2 =pca_result$x[, 2])
combined_data <- cbind(filtered_df_diag1[,c(1:7)], pc_scores)
combined_data$neu_dev<-as.factor(combined_data$neu_dev)
# Calculate the proportion of variance explained by each PC
explained_variance <- pca_result$sdev^2
explained_variance_percentage <- explained_variance / sum(explained_variance) * 100

# Create a string for the explained variance to use in axis titles
explained_variance_text1 <- paste("Explained Variance (PC1: ", 
                                  round(explained_variance_percentage[1], 2),"%)"
)
explained_variance_text2 <- paste("Explained Variance (PC2: ", 
                                  round(explained_variance_percentage[2], 2), "%)"
)


pca_plot <- ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = TP)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.8, size=3) + # Adjust point transparency and size
  scale_color_viridis_d() + # Use a more distinct color palette
  labs(
    title = "",
    subtitle = "Visualization of samples based on PC1 and PC2",
    x = paste(explained_variance_text1, "(PC1)"), 
    y = paste(explained_variance_text2, "(PC2)"),
    color = "Time Point"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # Removes major grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # Removes minor grid lines
    axis.line.x = element_line(color="black", size=0.5), # Adds a line at the bottom x-axis
    axis.line.y = element_line(color="black", size=0.5), # Adds a line at the left y-axis
    panel.border = element_blank(), # Removes the default border to avoid duplication
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=6)))

print(pca_plot)

replacements <- setNames(c("Mother week24","Mother week1","6 months", "18 months", "6 years","10 years"), c("Mor_w24","Mor_w1","6mth", "18mth", "6yr","10yr"))
combined_data$TP <- with(combined_data, ifelse(TP %in% names(replacements), replacements[TP], TP))


pca_plot <- ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = TP)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.8, size=3) + # Adjust point transparency and size
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") + # Use the "Paired" palette
  labs(
    title = "Visualization of samples based on PC1 and PC2",
    subtitle = "",
    x = paste(explained_variance_text1, "(PC1)"), 
    y = paste(explained_variance_text2, "(PC2)"),
    color = "Time Point"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # Removes major grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # Removes minor grid lines
    axis.line.x = element_line(color="black", size=0.5), # Adds a line at the bottom x-axis
    axis.line.y = element_line(color="black", size=0.5), # Adds a line at the left y-axis
    panel.border = element_blank(), # Removes the default border to avoid duplication
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=6)))

print(pca_plot)
```
